mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and 60 degree temperatures near Badger Ridge Middle School. The air quality index is currently 52, and under this beautiful Full Moon, the space station will be visible tonight starting at 3:27 AM, moving from the West Northwest over Cross Plains toward the Northeast near the Home Depot, where it will remain low near the horizon.

September is busy with local proclamations. Mayor Diaz has designated September 2026 as Hunger Action Month to support our neighbors facing food insecurity, and September as Suicide Prevention Month to provide resources for mental health. Also, note that flaggers will be on Highway M this Monday and Tuesday for construction, and we are celebrating our building and code staff for their commitment to public safety.

There is plenty to do this weekend! Today, catch the Dane County Farmers Market, or enjoy live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the Verona Area Kids Triathlon kicks off at the High School, and girls can try out hockey for free at the Verona Ice Arena.
For this week's police report, on August 21, an officer conducted a traffic stop for expired registration and subsequently cited the driver for possession of marijuana.
Today's delicious flavor is Mint Explosion. The store opens today at 10:00 AM and will be serving up treats until 10:30 PM.
